disease_label_per_paper: Secondary hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis in an HIV patient with EBV DNAemia and occult Hodgkin lymphoma
presentation_summary: History of HIV and non-compliance with HAART
One month of confusion, fevers, fatigue, and night sweats
Admission labs showed hemoglobin 4.6 g/dL, lactate 2.8, INR 3.9, CD4 count 51/mm3, HIV viral load less than 20, and otherwise normal leukocyte count
Persistent fever and hypotension despite broad antimicrobials; cultures remained unrevealing
Transferred to ICU on day 6 requiring vasopressors and intubation for worsening encephalopathy
Abdominal CT showed splenomegaly and multiple hypodense lesions in liver and spleen
EBV DNA 64,000 copies/mL, ferritin 2,512 ng/mL, platelets fell to 17,000/uL, and bone marrow biopsy confirmed hemophagocytic cells

actual_treatment: piperacillin-tazobactam, vancomycin, trimethoprim-sulfamethoxazole, and acyclovir before HLH recognition
HLH-94 protocol with etoposide and dexamethasone
outcome: Died on hospital day 12 after worsening hypotension, acidosis, renal failure, and inability to tolerate hemodialysis
quality_warnings: This case is secondary HLH with mixed infectious/immunosuppression/malignancy trigger context.
Bone marrow hemophagocytosis is a confirmatory axis included for full-evidence testing; remove it for presentation-only diagnostic testing.
Some key HLH criteria such as fibrinogen and triglycerides were not reported for this case and are not imputed.
